ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution dominated by low-intensity (black) pixels with a sparse population of high-intensity (white) localized pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Homogeneous dark pigment across both lobes; white punctate and annular markers distributed across the ventral surface, including a prominent cluster on the distal right lobe and scattered individuals on the medial left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central notch with an approximate 50-degree internal angle and deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous serrated trailing edge; left lobe displays low-frequency, rounded serrations; right lobe displays high-frequency, jagged peaks, particularly at the distal extremity.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave trailing edge geometry terminating in pointed distal tips that sweep upward and outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of white annular (ring-shaped) and circular scars ranging from 3 to 15 pixels in diameter across the entirety of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine white linear markings (rake marks) observed medially on the left lobe and lower-medially on the right lobe, oriented diagonally to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant permanent white scarring (rosettes) from past barnacle colonization distributed across the dark ventral surface.
